name: What is discovery in a San Diego misdemeanor case?

mainEntity.name: What is discovery in a San Diego misdemeanor case?

acceptedAnswer.text: Discovery is the legal process where prosecution and defense exchange evidence and witness lists before trial. Your attorney reviews discovery to prepare your defense.sandiegocounty​
